name: jev-use
verified_notes: Verified against the installed CLI on 2026-09-23. `jev-use install claude` wires an MCP SERVER, not a hook -- so what its installer registers is a tool the model may call, not a gate that intercepts. Its own --help documents a second surface, `jev-use hook gate`, as the 'PreToolUse hook adapter (Claude Code / Codex)', and that is what is measured here; the row is that documented adapter, not the MCP tool. Output follows Claude Code's convention: a deny/ask prints {"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":...}} and an ALLOW prints NOTHING AT ALL. All three decisions appear in the shipped code. Credentials: it auto-detects TYPESAFE_API_KEY / OPENROUTER_API_KEY / AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY; `jev-use doctor` made a live round trip on ours (332ms, model jev-1.13.0). Without a key it prints `jev-use hook: fail-open (...)` ON STDERR and exits 0 with an EMPTY STDOUT -- byte-identical to a genuine allow -- so the fail_open_markers below are checked before silence is read as permission.
